design_description: A sophisticated SC Cuenca design built around traditional vertical stripes, reworked in a darker, more premium palette of deep burgundy and black. Each stripe carries a subtle repeating chevron texture, adding depth and movement while preserving the classic striped identity. The black raglan-style sleeves and shoulders create a strong frame around the patterned torso, while gold accents on the collar, sleeve cuffs and side panels introduce a refined contrast that connects directly with the club crest. The SC Cuenca crest sits cleanly on the left chest, while the Momuto branding is rendered entirely in gold on the opposite side. The absence of a central sponsor keeps the front particularly clean and allows the stripe structure to remain the main visual element. Overall, it combines a traditional football aesthetic with a modern technical treatment: burgundy-and-black vertical stripes, understated chevron detailing, structured black shoulders and carefully controlled gold highlights.
